rules.label: First degree with the Computer Science background RWTH requires (applied, technical and theoretical computer science, and mathematics)

check.note: The RWTH examination board decides from your transcript and module descriptions whether your degree has the required background in applied, technical and theoretical computer science and mathematics (R01).

citations.quote: Based on the application documents, the examination board will decide on whether the applicant meets the above educational admission requirements.
Applied computer science: programming, data structures and algorithms, databases and information systems, software engineering

rules.label: GRE General Test if your first degree is from outside the European Union: Quantitative above the 75th percentile, Verbal above the 15th percentile, Writing at least 3.5

citations.quote: if your first degree is from outside the European Union, you are required to submit a GRE test certificate.
You need to be above 75th percentile in quantitative reasoning (GRE-QR) and above 15th percentile in verbal reasoning (GRE-VR).
Additionally you need at least 3.5 points in analytical writing (GRE-AW).

rules.label: Proof of English, needed to enrol: TOEFL iBT 90 (4.5 on the 2026 scale), IELTS 6.0, Cambridge B2 First grade B or better, C1 Advanced, C2 Proficiency, PTE Academic 60, UNIcert II or higher

children.note: Other English proof RWTH accepts is not modelled: a school certificate at level B2, an English-language bachelor's thesis (the examination board decides), the RWTH placement test for enrolled students. RWTH decides.

citations.quote: a) Test of English as Foreign Language (TOEFL) Internet-based Test (IBT) with a result of at least 90 points or a total score of 4,5
b) IELTS test with a score of at least 6.0
c) Cambridge Test -B2 First with a grade of at least B
f) Pearson Test of English (PTE) Academic with a result of at least 60 points
Applicants who have earned a high school diploma or academic degree in an English-speaking country are exempt from submitting proof of English language proficiency.
After a successful application, you still have submit proof of German and English language proficiency.
Aside from the evidence of English language proficiency listed there, other comparable evidence is also accepted.

rules.label: Proof of German at level C1, needed to enrol (not to be admitted), unless you are exempt

children.note: RWTH exempts some applicants from the German certificate (for example a German-language degree or a school-leaving certificate from a German-speaking country, or an Austrian degree). These exemptions are not modelled; RWTH decides.

citations.quote: After a successful application, you still have submit proof of German and English language proficiency.
Only applicants with a degree from certain German or English speaking countries are excempt from this regulation.
